items.title: Prohibited Jurisdictions
items.description: The T&Cs must contain a general prohibited jurisdictions list. Players residing in Curacao, the Netherlands (and any country forming part of the kingdom of the Netherlands), US, UN sanctioned countries and FATF blacklisted countries must not be allowed to register an account. Kindly amend.

items.title: Company Details & CGA Dynamic Seal
items.description: The registered domain must display the Curacao registered applicant entity's details and the CGA's dynamic seal on the homepage footer. Kindly amend. Please refer to the instructions on the following page for the proper display of the dynamic seal: https://portal.gamingcontrolcuracao.org/

items.title: Multiple Jurisdictions
items.description: It was noted that the registered domain is operated by a Brazil registered entity, duly authorised to operate in Brazil. Since the site appears to be targeted specifically for the Brazil market, does the applicant intend to offer the site to other markets or operate a separate domain under the CGA license? Kindly clarify and register all domains intended to be operated under the CGA license.

items.title: Governing Law
items.description: The T&Cs must be governed by the laws of Curacao. Kindly amend.

items.title: Site Language
items.description: The registered domain and all its contents must be made available in English. Kindly amend.

items.title: AML Policy
items.description: The AML policy must adhere to Curacao AML laws. Kindly amend.
